update_policy: manual, on explicit operator request only

repos.name: r2d2-trading-system
repos.description: Integrated US-equity research and paper-trading workspace: market data, screeners, relative strength, chart measurements, calibrated uncertainty ranges, independent agent books and a deterministic Strategy Lab with validation and forward trials.
repos.purpose: Trading and investing research with the complete integrated dashboard/runtime layout.
features: RS, momentum, sector and theme research
Deterministic Strategy Lab simulation and policy research
repos.run: See SETUP.md; production paths and credentials must be configured before enabling services.

repos.name: r2d2-agent-workflow
repos.description: Provider-independent project sessions and explicitly requested team discussion, with verbatim on-demand memory, token/cache accounting, usage guards, project trends and Git/instruction provenance. Reusable without the trading engine.
repos.purpose: Operate independent model sessions and inspect their work, memory and resource use without the trading engine.
repos.run: python3 check.py; then python3 -m venv .venv and install requirements.txt; optional provider/Telegram authentication is separate.

repos.name: r2d2-browser-research-tools
repos.description: Python helpers for Chrome/CDP automation, static fetching, clean article extraction, video captions and local browser/desktop capture. Uses your own local browser setup; no profiles, cookies or accounts are included.
repos.purpose: Reusable browser and research helpers, separate from trading and agent memory.
features: Static fetching and clean article extraction
repos.run: python3 check.py; pip install -r requirements.txt; see README for helper commands and browser setup.

repos.name: r2d2-knowledge-tools
repos.description: Deterministic document extraction and chapter preparation, Markdown wiki bookkeeping and Python AST code graphs. Standard-library-first helpers for compact, on-demand knowledge workflows without automatic model calls.
repos.purpose: Build compact reusable knowledge from documents and inspect source relationships without a trading service.
features: PDF, text, HTML, EPUB and DOCX extraction
repos.run: python3 check.py; python3 book-to-skill/scripts/extract.py --check; python3 wiki/wiki.py --help.

repos.name: r2d2-agent-skills
repos.description: Mixed-provenance agent recipes, supporting scripts and references for research, debugging, verification, browser work, knowledge and design. Includes local integrations and preserves available upstream attribution and licenses.
repos.purpose: Preserve the instruction/tool recipes shared by our coding and research agents.
repos.run: Read README; install selected skills into the agent skill directory. Skills require their named external tools.

repos.name: r2d2-wifi-guard
repos.description: Linux NetworkManager watchdog that reconnects a saved Wi-Fi connection, records outages and supports pause/resume controls. Includes an optional Gtk status window, queued Telegram notices and manually installed service examples.
repos.purpose: Keep a Linux workstation reachable using its existing NetworkManager saved connection.
repos.run: See README; bash -n bin/wifi-guard; configure NetworkManager before installing the optional service.

repos.name: r2d2-linux-system-tools
repos.description: Explicit-use Linux maintenance scripts for offline backups, local Git checkpoints, desktop/graphics setup, image montages, hardware inspection and launcher wrappers. Host configuration and private recovery archives stay local.
repos.purpose: Preserve the workstation maintenance scripts independently from application code.
repos.run: python3 check.py; read each script before running it. Backup outputs contain private state and must stay outside GitHub.

repos.name: r2d2-chart-indicator-research
repos.description: Explainable Pine Script research prototype for multi-colour candle states, with a technical study of momentum, trend, volatility and hysteresis. A behavioral approximation, not proprietary source, a verified clone or a profitability claim.
repos.purpose: Preserve the standalone indicator study separately from active trading rules.
repos.run: Read report.md; review/import the Pine source manually in TradingView. No claim of exact equivalence or profitability.

repos.name: r2d2-productivity-connectors
repos.description: Small standard-library SMTP and Google Tasks helpers with explicit action APIs, OAuth setup and duplicate-aware note transfer. No background sending, stored credentials, inbox reader or automatic two-way sync.
repos.purpose: Keep personal productivity connectors independent of market analysis and agent orchestration.
repos.run: python3 check.py; read USAGE.md before configuring accounts. External sending or account writes require an explicit task.

repos.name: r2d2-workspace-catalog
repos.description: Public catalogue of the R2D2 source repositories, with detailed guides, source ownership maps, release/privacy verification and explicit export/update tools. No automatic synchronization or publishing jobs.
repos.purpose: The starting point for finding, restoring and explicitly updating all saved work.
repos.run: python3 export.py --list; updates require an explicit --repo selection and publishing is a separate command.
